Barlas: stainless steel insulated tanker manufacturing

Specialising in stainless steel insulated tankers, Barlas maintains its leading position in the sector. These tankers provide a reliable and effective solution, primarily for chemical and hazardous goods transport. Stainless steel insulated tankers manufactured by Barlas are produced from high-quality materials through dedicated design and manufacturing processes.

Barlas manufactures its stainless steel insulated tankers with solutions customised to customer requirements and in compliance with industry standards. Each tanker is built from durable, corrosion-resistant materials for long service life, and is equipped with high leak-tightness characteristics and designs that meet safety standards.

Using the latest technology in its production processes, Barlas aims to deliver maximum performance and efficiency. The insulation technologies used in stainless steel insulated tankers provide temperature control and protection against environmental effects, taking product safety to the highest level.

Committed to environmentally friendly production principles, Barlas also takes a responsible approach to waste management and energy efficiency. The recyclability of the materials chosen for stainless steel insulated tankers and sustainable production processes help minimise environmental impact.

Developing flexible, customer-focused approaches to meet each customer's specific requirements, Barlas maintains its sector leadership by prioritising customer satisfaction through professional after-sales services and its technical support team.
For the shell, dished ends and pressure-bearing parts of the transport tank, P 355 grade steel sheet compliant with EN 10028-3 and meeting the properties required by the standard is used.
The material used is certified to at least 3.1b according to EN 10204.

The tank exterior is shot blasted to SA2.5 quality; shop primer is applied to the blasted surfaces, followed by epoxy primer and a white acrylic top coat.
In addition, a 30 cm wide red stripe is applied along the tank axis.

Double-deck extendable car carrier trailers are high-capacity transport solutions designed and built specifically for automobile transport. To increase the number of vehicles carried, these trailers are usually designed with a two-deck structure. The upper decks sit at different levels from the lower deck and are typically equipped with hydraulic or mechanical systems to allow vehicles to be loaded and unloaded.
The features that set double-deck extendable car carrier trailers apart are:
High capacity: thanks to their two-deck structure, they can carry more vehicles than single-deck trailers.
Flexible loading system: upper and lower decks equipped with hydraulic or mechanical systems allow vehicles to be loaded and unloaded quickly and safely.
Durability and safety: their robust structure and the securing systems used to fix the vehicles during transport keep the carried vehicles safe.
Long-distance transport: ideal for long-distance haulage, these trailers provide an important solution for car manufacturers, distributors and logistics companies.
Operational efficiency: their high capacity and fast loading/unloading systems increase operational efficiency and help reduce operating costs.

Car manufacturers, dealers, carriers and logistics companies widely use double-deck extendable car carrier trailers. These trailers are preferred especially in operations requiring the transport of large numbers of automobiles.
